title: What Is a Dictatorship and How Did Hitler Come to Power? A Dated Timeline
seoTitle: How Did Hitler Come to Power? Dictatorship Explained
seoDescription: Hitler was appointed, not elected, in January 1933, then used emergency decrees and the Enabling Act to end German democracy in just 18 months.
excerpt: The types of dictatorship, a date-by-date table of the 18 months that turned Germany's Chancellor into Führer, the warning signs scholars watch for, and the safeguards India added to its Emergency rules in 1978.
